name: PWAverse
description: ◍ The community home of Progressive Web Apps — an open-source, curated PWA directory that is itself an installable, offline-capable PWA.

paragraphs: An open-source, community-curated directory where anyone can discover, launch, and install the best apps of the open web — no app store, no gatekeepers, no downloads.

🌱 The dream: an ecosystem where PWAs are a first-class form of application — instant, installable, offline-capable, and working beautifully on any phone, from the newest flagship to a budget device on a 2G connection.

The web can do almost everything native apps can — offline support, push notifications, home-screen installation, hardware access — but great PWAs are nearly impossible to find. There is no living, community-owned place to discover them. PWAverse is that place.
features: 📚 Curated directory — every app lives in a simple JSON file the community owns
🔍 Instant search & category filters — no page loads, no lag
📴 Fully offline-capable — the directory is cached by a service worker
📲 Installable everywhere — native install prompt on Android/desktop, guided instructions on iOS
🌗 Dark & light themes — follows your system preference

whatItDoes.text: An open-source, community-curated directory where anyone can discover, launch, and install the best apps of the open web — no app store, no gatekeepers, no downloads.

requirements.text: 🎨 Real app icons — fetched automatically from each app's own manifest and self-hosted (no hotlinking, works offline); colored letter tiles as the fallback
